mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS id, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.member_id AS memberId, o.order_type AS orderType, o.status AS status, o.final_amount AS finalAmount, o.pickup_at AS pickupAt, o.created_at AS orderCreatedAt, o.updated_at AS orderUpdatedAt, '주문 케이크' AS representativeProductName FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'IN_PRODUCTION') AND DATE(o.pickup_at) = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY o.pickup_at ASC
